source.text: Builds on the stock ledger as built (Pharmacy Phases 1 and 2, feat/pharmacy-demo) and the Pharmacy Workspace v2 places. The ledger, FEFO, counts and witnesses do not change; this adds a shared catalogue above the hospital's products, scanning, a manual path with review, prices, and an import.
